title: AITask
description: A unit of AI work. An API key engine, AgentBinder or cloud credits can run it.

kind.description: Open set: ping, triage, failureReason, digest, changeSummary, draft, tidy, check, order, sessionSummary, sessionEnd, question, itemSummary.

text.description: The main input: item text, a log snippet, a diff.

context.description: Named extra inputs, for example labels or statuses.

AIResult.description: Store collection ai-results. The id is the task.

engine.description: Open set: api-key, and later agentbinder and cloud.
